body: Quick pass: merges cleanly with main; body complete; no snapshot PNG touched; author's gate green on 71a41715 (xtask 49, `icons --check` clean, ui lib 577, clippy clean, quick gate green). Flagged ready for the independent review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 71a41715a184092d983431f95cbf4251d2a6a90b -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers found. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**What looks good**
- Badge mapping (`tree_badges.rs` `status_badge`): refused (BLOCKED) wins, then Never/Stale, then Ok with warnings -> warning, else Ok. No state shows the OK badge while refused or stale. Pinned by `status_badge_follows_the_row_status`. Display only, no new state, no command, no Flecs calls from UI.
- Tool icons: `tool_icon` is an exhaustive `match` on `ToolKind` (compile-time), and `every_tool_kind_has_its_own_svg_mastered_icon` enumerates kinds through `ToolUi::tool_kind()` over 0..64, checks distinctness, `tool-*` prefix, SVG master present, and that no kind wears an operation's icon.
- Deleted PNGs (box-model, cube, debug-info, eye-off, eye, fixture, maximize, player-play, post, sim, transform): no remaining icon reference under `crates/`, `assets/`, `xtask/`.
- Sheet labels use a hand-drawn 3x5 bitmap font (`xtask/src/icon_font.rs`), no system font lookup, so the sheet is deterministic across machines. `Cargo.lock` unchanged. No `build.rs`, `.github/` or snapshot changes.
- SVG masters checked (text): all 31 new masters have `viewBox="0 0 24 24"`, stroke-width 2, a `<title>`, and plain path/rect/circle elements. No `<image`, `data:`, `href`, `xlink`, `url(http`, `<script>`, `<text>`, `<metadata>`, comments, or product names. Provenance beyond this rests on the author's statement.
- `Refs #661` (no closing keyword), `Changelog:` line present, `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` 25 -> 26 (xtask changed). Renumbering vs other open PRs is for the merger.

**Local results (PR head merged with origin/main 6f1adf06, trial merge local only)**
- `cargo test -p xtask`: 49 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo xtask icons --check`: 0 breaches.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`): 577 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run: snapshot suites (ignored by law), the app, other crates.

**Badge state table**

| Operation state | Badge |
|---|---|
| Never generated | never (ring) |
| Generated, no warnings | ok (check disc) |
| Stale | stale (clock) |
| Generated with warnings | warning (triangle) |
| Refused / BLOCKED (any state) | warning (triangle) |

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The tool-kind test only enumerates kinds reachable from the editor's numbering. Compile-time coverage comes from the exhaustive match, so a kind the editor cannot set would not be checked by the test.
- `painted.rs` is 414 lines (main already 419); `panes.rs` is pre-existing and large. Not a blocker.
- Look at the 16 px sheet (dark and light): badges differ in shape (disc, check, clock, triangle), not only colour. Reads clearly: end mill, ball nose, drill, tap, bore, plasma, the tree rows, the action icons. Weaker: `act-generate` (path plus arrow reads busy), `tool-form` (goggle-like), `tool-probe` and `op-probe` look alike at 16 px, and `tool-drill` and `op-drill` share a silhouette family. Worth a maintainer look, not a defect.
- Not exercised in the running app: badge placement and ground disc, picker glyph, tree rows at real DPI.
